# mtncloud_mos_bucket_logging (Resource)

Write a log of every request to a MOS bucket into another bucket. Destroy turns logging off; the logs already written stay.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket" "site" {
  name = "acme-website"
}

resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket" "logs" {
  name = "acme-access-logs"
}

resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket_logging" "site" {
  bucket        = mtncloud_mos_bucket.site.name
  target_bucket = mtncloud_mos_bucket.logs.name
  target_prefix = "website/"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) The bucket's name in MOS, usually `mtncloud_mos_bucket.<name>.name`. Changing it moves the setting to another bucket.
- `target_bucket` (String) The bucket the logs go to. Use another bucket: logging a bucket into itself writes a log for every log, without end.

### Optional

- `target_prefix` (String) Start every log's name with this, for example `logs/`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The bucket's name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mtncloud_mos_bucket_logging.site acme-website
```
